notes.title: [Patch v1.0.4a] Dreams of an Exile v1.0.4a is now available
notes.notes:
We’ve received feedback about a possible way to break Dreams of an Exile girls’ routes, so we’ve made a small patch to fix it. Thank Tuuo for reporting it!

Now, it’s not possible to access a specific area before the right moment for it. This will make you avoid the problem in which you can’t trigger one of Nessire’s cutscene.

Thank you all for using the game forum and Discord to report bugs and we hope you also enjoy our next yuri games. 

Have you wishlisted Magic Exposure? If not, do it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/Magic_Exposure__Yuri_Visual_Novel/

Don’t forget to follow our Steam page, we’re getting closer to 600 followers!

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3a
Patch 1.0.2a
notes.notes:
Now, after you die for the fourth time on the final boss, you'll be able to choose an easy battle. If you choose it, when the boss has 1 HP, it will spawn only one bomb that will destroy after 4 seconds.

Feel free to report any bugs on Discord or use the game forum.

Male Doll Team
